source_text: Superiores duos Peri Archon libellos... (Rufinus pref); De libero arbitrio...
pass_a_gloss: Rufinus: I translated the first two books under pressure in Lent; now free decision.
pass_b_english: Rufinus notes he finished Books I–II under pressure in Lent and moves more slowly through III–IV. The treatise turns to free decision: praise and blame, commandments, and apostolic warnings only make sense if the rational creature is [[self-determining >> Bible:Deuteronomy 30:19]], not moved as a mere tool.
